evals.prompt: The checkout-redesign spec is done. Pull out what we should remember from it.
evals.expected_output: The assistant analyses the spec's execution artifacts, compares them with existing memories, and proposes ranked candidates with types, without writing memories before the user picks.
assertions: The assistant reads the completed spec's artifacts
Candidates are ranked and each has a proposed memory type
Conflicts with existing memories are flagged
No memory is written before the user chooses candidates

evals.prompt: Extract memories from specs/auth-migration. We fixed the token refresh race in that spec.
evals.expected_output: Candidates include the fixed race, and any existing redflag about it is identified as resolved.
assertions: A candidate covers the token refresh race fix
An existing redflag about the race, if present, is flagged as resolved
